submission.justification: Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm provides the best time resolution (0.89 ns) among all candidate mixtures and gap sizes, per detailed simulation. This mixture and gap are fully compatible with the laboratory's high-voltage and gas-recirculation systems (ensuring environmental policy compliance), and are among the approved candidates. The gap is within the required 1–3 mm range. This choice maximizes detector performance and satisfies all technical, safety, and schedule constraints.
